blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nitrogen and Sulfur) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 A solution containing 12.8 g of ammonium nitrite is heated slowly. Calculate the mass of nitrogen gas and of water formed. (N = 14.01, H = 1.008, O = 16.00 g mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(12.8 g ammonium nitrite wala solution aahista garam kiya jata hai. Banne wali nitrogen gas aur paani ka mass nikalein. (N = 14.01, H = 1.008, O = 16.00 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Balanced equation istemal karein: 1 mol NH₄NO₂ se 1 mol N₂ aur 2 mol H₂O.

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is NH₄NO₂(aq) → N₂(g) + 2H₂O(l).

steps: Molar masses: NH₄NO₂ = 2(14.01) + 4(1.008) + 2(16.00) = 64.05 g mol⁻¹; N₂ = 28.02 g mol⁻¹; H₂O = 18.02 g mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
2 Explain the bonding in the N₂ molecule and give the reasons for its low reactivity. How is this inertness useful? (4 marks)
(N₂ molecule ki bonding samjhayein aur us ki kam reactivity ki wajohaat batayein. Yeh be-asri (inertness) kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Bonding: Nitrogen ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2p³ hai aur octet ke liye teen electrons chahiye. Do N atoms teen teen electrons share karke triple bond N≡N banate hain (Figure 12.1).

Kam reactivity ki wajohaat:
(i) Mazboot triple bond: bond enthalpy +944 kJ mol⁻¹, naye bond se pehle ise torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye.
(ii) Nonpolar bond: dono atoms aik jaise, electronegativity ka farq sifar, electrons barabar share hote hain.
(iii) Chhota size aur symmetrical electronic cloud.

Faide: hawa ki nitrogen oxygen ko dilute karti hai taake har chingari se aag na lage; jahazon par nitrogen ke blankets hydrocarbons aur tail ko oxygen aur nami se bachate hain; laboratory mein inert mahaul deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen is a significant component of the air, known for its low reactivity

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the shapes of ammonia and the ammonium ion and explain why the shape changes. Show how ammonia acts as a Lowry-Brønsted base in water. (4 marks)
(Ammonia aur ammonium ion ki shakal bayan karein aur batayein shakal kyun badalti hai. Dikhayein ke ammonia paani mein Lowry-Brønsted base kaise hai.)
blocks.explanation:
NH₃ ki shakal: nitrogen teen N–H bonds banati hai aur aik lone pair rakhti hai. Lone pair ki wajah se ammonia pyramidal hai.

NH₄⁺ ki shakal: jab nitrogen yeh lone pair H⁺ se bond mein laga deti hai to koi lone pair nahi bachta. Ammonium ion tetrahedral ho jata hai, chaaron N–H bonds lambai aur taqat mein barabar (Figure 12.2).

Base ka rawayya: Lowry-Brønsted base proton leta hai. NH₃(aq) + H⁺(aq) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq). Paani mein: NH₃(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ NH₄⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq), Kb = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵.

Kb kam hai, equilibrium bohat baayen taraf hai, is liye ammonia ka solution (ammonium hydroxide) kamzor base hai.

book_ref.quote: when nitrogen atom in ammonia utilizes this lone pair of electrons to form ammonium

blocks.prompt:
4 Ammonia is prepared by heating 16.05 g of ammonium chloride with excess calcium hydroxide. Calculate the mass of ammonia and of calcium chloride formed. (NH₄Cl = 53.49, NH₃ = 17.03, CaCl₂ = 110.98 g mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(16.05 g ammonium chloride ko zyada calcium hydroxide ke saath garam karke ammonia banai jati hai. Ammonia aur calcium chloride ka mass nikalein. (NH₄Cl = 53.49, NH₃ = 17.03, CaCl₂ = 110.98 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Balanced equation: 2 mol NH₄Cl se 2 mol NH₃ aur 1 mol CaCl₂.

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is 2NH₄Cl(s) + Ca(OH)₂ → CaCl₂ + 2H₂O(l) + 2NH₃(g).

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the common oxides of nitrogen, giving their formulas, oxidation states, properties and uses. (4 marks)
(Nitrogen ke aam oxides ke formulas, oxidation states, properties aur istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ke oxides NO, N₂O, NO₂, N₂O₄ aur N₂O₅ hain, oxidation states +1 se +5 tak. N₂O₄ aur N₂O₅ jaldi toot jaate hain. NO aur NO₂ ko mila kar NOₓ kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The structures, properties and uses of these oxides are given in Table 12.2

rows: Be-rang, paani mein hal, neutral, meethi boo, jalne mein madad
Daanton ki anaesthetic, whipped ice cream ka propellant, NaN₃ banana
Nitric oxide, NO, aur dimer N₂O₂ (+2)
Be-rang, thora hal, neutral; NO (11 valence electrons) paramagnetic, N₂O₂ diamagnetic; oxidising bhi reducing bhi
Biochemical messenger (blood pressure kam), nitrosyl carbonyls banana
NO₂ surkhi maail bhoori, paramagnetic, paani se HNO₃ aur HNO₂; N₂O₄ be-rang; 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄ (thanda: aage, garam: peeche)
Rocket propellant, Ostwald process se HNO₃, explosives

blocks.prompt:
6 What are the natural and man-made sources of NOₓ? Explain how photochemical smog differs from classical smog and name its photochemical oxidants. (4 marks)
(NOₓ ke qudrati aur insani zariye kya hain? Photochemical smog classical smog se kaise mukhtalif hai aur us ke photochemical oxidants ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qudrati zariye: bijli (hawa ki N₂ aur O₂ se NO), volcanoes, biological decay, jangal ki aag, mitti ke microorganisms aur samandar.
Insani zariye: zyada tar gaariyon aur power plants mein fossil fuels ka jalna; chemical plants, biomass jalana aur welding bhi.

Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs se banti hai aur oxidising hai. Classical smog London smog hai. NOₓ ke barhte ikhraj ki wajah se photochemical smog zyada aam ho rahi hai.

Photochemical oxidants: NO₂, ozone (O₃) aur peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs); yeh fiza mein cheezon ko oxidise karte hain. Lahore smog mein VOCs, NOₓ, O₃, PM2.5, CO aur SO₂ hain.

book_ref.quote: It is oxidising in nature. Photochemical oxidants

blocks.prompt:
7 Write the three reactions that take place in a three-way catalytic converter, name the catalyst, and show which substance is reduced and which is oxidised in each. (4 marks)
(Three-way catalytic converter ke teen reactions likhein, catalyst ka naam batayein, aur har aik mein dikhayein kaun reduce aur kaun oxidise hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Catalytic converter ceramic ya metallic honeycomb monolith hai jis ki naaliyon par alumina (zyada surface area) aur us par Pt, Pd, Rh hoti hain. Yeh teen redox reactions se CO, NO aur hydrocarbons ko CO₂, N₂ aur paani banati hain.

1. NO ki reduction: 2NO(g) + 2CO(g) → N₂(g) + 2CO₂(g) (Pt/Rh). N +2 se 0 (NO reduce); C +2 se +4 (CO oxidise).

2. CO ki oxidation: 2CO(g) + O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) (Pt/Rh). Carbon +2 → +4 (oxidise); oxygen 0 → −2 (reduce).

3. Hydrocarbons ki oxidation: 2C₂H₄ + 6O₂(g) → 4CO₂(g) + 4H₂O(g) (Pt/Rh). Hydrocarbon oxidise ho kar CO₂ aur paani; O₂ reduce.

Qeemti metals khatam nahi hotin aur recycle ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: These metals catalyze three redox reactions

blocks.prompt:
8 Compare nitrification and denitrification, giving the conditions, the change in nitrogen, the equations and their importance. (4 marks)
(Nitrification aur denitrification ka muqabla karein: halaat, nitrogen ki tabdeeli, equations aur ahmiyat.)
blocks.explanation: Nitrification aur denitrification nitrogen cycle ke do marhale hain; dono wastewater se nitrogen nikalne mein bhi kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: Nitrification involves the conversion of ammonium

rows: Ammonia/NH₄⁺ nitrite (NO₂⁻) aur nitrate (NO₃⁻) mein badalti hai
Nitrite aur nitrate wapis N₂ bante hain jo fiza mein jaati hai
Nitrogen ki oxidation: NH₄⁺ → NO₂⁻ → NO₃⁻
Nitrogen ki reduction: NO₃⁻ → NO₂⁻ → NO → N₂O → N₂
Paude nitrites aur nitrates jazb karte hain, N₂ seedha nahi le sakte
Wastewater treatment aur aabi zindagi ke liye aham

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe sulfur with reference to its position, physical properties, catenation and oxidation states. (4 marks)
(Sulfur ko us ki jagah, physical properties, catenation aur oxidation states ke hawale se bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jagah: sulfur (atomic number 16, [Ne] 3s² 3p⁴) group 16, chalcogen family ka member hai.

Physical properties (Table 12.4): peela thos; relative atomic mass 32.06; melting point 113 °C (shehad jaisa peela liquid); boiling point 445 °C (gehra bhoora); electronegativity 2.5; density 2.07 g/cm³; covalent bonding.

Catenation: orbitals ki kamzor overlapping ki wajah se sulfur double ki bajaye single bonds banata hai, is liye catenation se bare molecules (rings, chains) banata hai; S₈ taaj numa molecule hai (Figure 12.7).

Oxidation states: −2, 0, +2, +4 aur +6, configuration ke unpaired electrons se tay (Figure 12.8); +4 aur +6 aam hain. Standard halaat mein SO₂ (+4) banti hai, SO₃ (+6) ke liye zyada energy chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Sulfur usually forms single bonds with other sulfur atoms instead of double bonds

blocks.prompt:
10 What is a Frost diagram? Explain how it is related to ΔG° and how it is used to judge the stability of oxidation states and the oxidising or reducing power of a couple. (4 marks)
(Frost diagram kya hai? ΔG° se is ka talluq aur oxidation states ki stability aur couple ki oxidising/reducing taqat jaanchne mein is ka istemal samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: element X ka Frost diagram couple X(n)/X(0) ke liye nE° aur oxidation state (n) ka graph hai. Yeh pH = 0 (acidic) aur pH = 14 (basic) par oxidation states ki nisbati stability dikhata hai.

ΔG° se talluq: −ΔG° = nFE°, ya −ΔG°/F = nE°; E° standard reduction potential, F Faraday constant, n muntaqil electrons. Is liye ise Gibbs free energy banaam oxidation state ka graph bhi keh sakte hain.

Stability: zyada stable state ka nE° kam (Gibbs free energy zyada manfi) hota hai, is liye sab se stable state sab se neeche hoti hai.

Oxidising/reducing taqat: zyada musbat slope wala couple acha oxidising agent, zyada manfi slope wala acha reducing agent.

book_ref.quote: It can also be regarded as a plot between standard reaction Gibb

blocks.prompt:
11 For an element X, the couple X(+4)/X(0) has E° = +0.45 V and the couple X(+6)/X(0) has E° = +0.36 V. Calculate nE° and ΔG° for each, and state which of the two oxidation states is more stable relative to X(0). (F = 96485 C mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Element X ke couple X(+4)/X(0) ka E° = +0.45 V aur X(+6)/X(0) ka E° = +0.36 V hai. Har aik ka nE° aur ΔG° nikalein aur batayein dono mein se kaun si oxidation state X(0) ke muqable mein zyada stable hai. (F = 96485 C mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: nE° = n × E° aur ΔG° = −nFE° istemal karein; kam nE° wali state zyada stable hai.

book_ref.quote: Here E⁰ is the standard reduction potential

steps: Frost diagram mein kam nE° wali state zyada stable hai: 1.80 V < 2.16 V.
blocks.final_answer: nE°(+4) = 1.80 V, ΔG° ≈ −173.7 kJ mol⁻¹; nE°(+6) = 2.16 V, ΔG° ≈ −208.4 kJ mol⁻¹. +4 state (kam nE°) neeche hai aur zyada stable hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Frost diagram mein ooper ki qeemat nE° hai. Jo state jitni neeche (kam nE°) ho woh utni stable hai. Yahan +4 ka nE° 1.80 V aur +6 ka 2.16 V hai, is liye +4 neeche aur zyada stable hai.

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the reactions of sulfur with oxygen, nitric acid, metals and potassium cyanide, giving equations. (4 marks)
(Sulfur ke oxygen, nitric acid, metals aur potassium cyanide se reactions equations ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sulfur bohat se elements se milta hai; paani, halke non-oxidising acids aur noble gases se react nahi karta; catenation se rings aur chains banata hai.

1. Oxygen ke saath: hawa mein neele shole se: S(s) + O₂(g) → SO₂(g). SO₃ ke liye zyada temperature aur catalyst: 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2SO₃(g) (garmi, Pt).

2. Nitric acid ke saath: S(s) + 6HNO₃(l) → H₂SO₄(l) + 6NO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l).

3. Metals ke saath: sulfur oxidizing agent ban kar sulfides banata hai; Ag, Cu, Zn ko daagdaar karta hai: 2Ag + S → Ag₂S; Hg + S → HgS; 2Cu + S → Cu₂S. Au aur Pt se react nahi karta.

4. Potassium cyanide ke saath: KCN(s) + S(s) → KSCN(s) (garmi). Thiocyanate (pseudohalide) Fe³⁺ ke analysis mein kaam aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Sulfur can combine with many elements to form a wide variety of inorganic and organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
13 A batch of 404.4 g of gunpowder is burned. Calculate (i) the masses of KNO₃, charcoal and sulfur in it and (ii) the moles of gas produced, using 10KNO₃ + 3S + 8C → 2K₂CO₃ + 3K₂SO₄ + 6CO₂ + 5N₂. (KNO₃ = 101.11 g mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(404.4 g gunpowder jalaya jata hai. (i) Is mein KNO₃, koyle aur sulfur ka mass aur (ii) banne wali gas ke mol nikalein, 10KNO₃ + 3S + 8C → 2K₂CO₃ + 3K₂SO₄ + 6CO₂ + 5N₂ se. (KNO₃ = 101.11 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Tarkeeb 75 : 15 : 10 lagayein, phir KNO₃ aur gas (CO₂ + N₂) ki mole nisbat.

book_ref.quote: Gun powder is a coarse blend of 75% potassium nitrate

steps: Gas: 10 mol KNO₃ se 6 mol CO₂ + 5 mol N₂ = 11 mol; to 3.000 × 11/10 = 3.30 mol (1.80 mol CO₂ + 1.50 mol N₂).
blocks.final_answer: (i) KNO₃ 303.3 g, koyla 60.66 g, sulfur 40.44 g; (ii) 3.30 mol gas.

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the uses of sulfur in vulcanisation and as a fertiliser, and the role of sulfur compounds in drugs, dyes and fragrances. (4 marks)
(Vulcanisation aur fertiliser mein sulfur ke istemal, aur dawaon, dyes aur khushbuon mein sulfur compounds ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Vulcanisation: sulfur rubber ki chains ke darmiyan S–S pul banata hai jis se rubber mazboot hota hai.

Fertiliser: sulfur paudon ke liye zaroori ghiza hai. Kami wali mitti mein sulfur wale N/P fertilizers ya sulfur-coated urea daalte hain; mitti ke ajza aur microbes sulfur ko hal hone wali shakal mein badalte hain. Gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O) bhi istemal hota hai.

Organic sulfur compounds: C–S bonds se thiols (mercaptans), thioethers, sulfoxides, sulfones.
Dawaen: sulfa drugs antibacterial sulfonamides hain; penicillins aur cephalosporins (beta-lactam antibiotics) ke rings mein bhi sulfur hai; omeprazole (GERD) mein sulfoxide group hai.
Dyes: nitro ya amino groups wale compounds ki thionation se; kaala, bhoora, khaki, neela, hara rang (sulfur black 1, sulfur blue, sulfur brilliant green).
Khushbu: mercaptans natural gas ko boo dete hain; thioterpineol grapefruit ki khushboo; cis-galbanum oxathiane fragrances, sabun aur shampoo mein.

book_ref.quote: These bonds form a large number of organic compounds containing a variety of functional groups

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the first two stages of the contact process: the sulfur/pyrite burners and the purification unit, with equations. (4 marks)
(Contact process ke pehle do marhale, sulfur/pyrite burners aur purification unit, equations ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sulphuric acid contact process se banta hai (flow sheet, Figure 12.12).

1. Sulfur/pyrite burners: pighle sulfur ko jala kar, ya iron pyrite (FeS₂) ko zyada hawa mein garam karke SO₂ banti hai:
S(s) + O₂(g) → SO₂(g), ΔH = −297.03 kJ mol⁻¹
4FeS₂(s) + 11O₂(g) → 2Fe₂O₃(s) + 8SO₂(g)

2. Purification unit: pyrite se bani SO₂ mein gard, bukharat aur arsenic oxide ho sakte hain jo catalyst ki karkardagi kharab karte hain, is liye gas saaf ki jati hai. Arsenic purifier mein ufqi shelves par gelatinous Fe(OH)₃ arsenic oxide jazb karta hai:
As₂O₃ + 2Fe(OH)₃ → 2FeAsO₃ + 3H₂O

Phir saaf SO₂ aur hawa contact tower mein jaati hain.

book_ref.quote: The Contact process can be divided into the following stages

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the contact tower and the absorption tower of the contact process, including the catalytic action and the formation of oleum. (4 marks)
(Contact process ke contact tower aur absorption tower ko catalyst ke amal aur oleum banne samet bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Contact tower: saaf SO₂ aur hawa 420–450 °C tak garam karke 1–2 atm par V₂O₅ catalyst par di jaati hai:
SO₂(g) + ½O₂(g) ⇌ SO₃(g), ΔH = −98.98 kJ mol⁻¹
Catalyst do qadam mein kaam karta hai:
(i) V⁵⁺ SO₂ ko oxidise karta hai: SO₂(g) + V₂O₅(s) → SO₃(g) + V₂O₄(s)
(ii) Oxygen catalyst wapis banati hai: V₂O₄(s) + ½O₂(g) → V₂O₅(s)

Absorption tower: SO₃ thandi ki jati hai. Paani se reaction H₂O(l) + SO₃(g) → H₂SO₄(l) (ΔH = −176.6 kJ mol⁻¹) bohat exothermic hai aur tezaabi dhund (mist) banata hai, is liye seedha nahi kiya jata. SO₃ garam 98.5 % sulphuric acid mein hal ki jati hai. SO₃ aur 100 % acid ka mixture oleum (fuming sulphuric acid) hai:
H₂SO₄(l) + SO₃(g) → H₂S₂O₇(l)
Phir oleum ko paani se mila kar tay shuda concentration ka acid banta hai:
H₂S₂O₇(l) + H₂O(l) → 2H₂SO₄(l)

book_ref.quote: Purified SO₂ and air, preheated at 420 °C– 450 °C

blocks.prompt:
17 In a sulfur burner, 100 g of sulfur is burned completely. Calculate the heat released, and the heat released when all the SO₂ formed is then converted into SO₃. (S = 32.06 g mol⁻¹; S + O₂ → SO₂, ΔH = −297.03 kJ mol⁻¹; SO₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ SO₃, ΔH = −98.98 kJ mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(Sulfur burner mein 100 g sulfur poora jalaya jata hai. Nikalne wali garmi nikalein, aur woh garmi bhi jab tamaam bani SO₂ SO₃ mein badle. (S = 32.06 g mol⁻¹; S + O₂ → SO₂, ΔH = −297.03 kJ mol⁻¹; SO₂ + ½O₂ ⇌ SO₃, ΔH = −98.98 kJ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: S ke mol nikalein; 1 mol S se 1 mol SO₂, us se 1 mol SO₃; har ΔH se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: The process starts with the combustion of molten sulphur

steps: Bani SO₂ = 3.119 mol, jis se 3.119 mol SO₃.
blocks.final_answer: Jalne se 926.5 kJ; SO₃ banne se mazeed 308.7 kJ (kul taqreeban 1235 kJ).

blocks.prompt:
18 50.0 g of oleum, H₂S₂O₇, is diluted with water. Calculate the mass of sulphuric acid formed and the mass of water used. (H = 1.008, S = 32.06, O = 16.00 g mol⁻¹; H₂SO₄ = 98.08 g mol⁻¹) (4 marks)
(50.0 g oleum, H₂S₂O₇, ko paani se patla kiya jata hai. Banne wale sulphuric acid aur istemal hone wale paani ka mass nikalein. (H = 1.008, S = 32.06, O = 16.00 g mol⁻¹; H₂SO₄ = 98.08 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: H₂S₂O₇ + H₂O → 2H₂SO₄: har mol oleum 1 mol paani leta aur 2 mol acid deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Oleum undergoes a reaction with water to make a highly concentrated solution

blocks.final_answer: Sulphuric acid = 55.06 g (taqreeban 55.1 g); paani = 5.06 g.

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe the structure and the physical properties of sulphuric acid. (4 marks)
(Sulphuric acid ki banawat aur physical properties bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: sulfur ka taqreeban 85 % H₂SO₄ banane mein lagta hai. Molecule mein sulfur ke gird tetrahedral banawat hai: do S−O bonds (OH groups se) aur do S=O bonds (Figure 12.11).

Physical properties: paani mein hal aur hygroscopic, hawa se nami jazb karta hai. Anhydrous H₂SO₄ bohat polar liquid hai. Bohat corrosive hai aur jild jalata hai, is liye ehtiyat se istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: Anhydrous H₂SO₄ is a very polar liquid

blocks.prompt:
20 Discuss the acidic behaviour of sulphuric acid: its self-ionization, its two ionization steps in water, and its reactions with sodium chloride and with metals above hydrogen. (4 marks)
(Sulphuric acid ke tezaabi rawayye par baat karein: self-ionization, paani mein do ionization qadam, aur sodium chloride aur hydrogen se ooper wali metals se reactions.)
blocks.explanation:
Self-ionization: H₂SO₄(l) + H₂SO₄(l) ⇌ H₃SO₄⁺ + HSO₄⁻, K = 2.7 × 10⁻⁴. Yeh paani se zyada hai, is liye H₂SO₄ non-aqueous protic solvent hai.

Paani mein ionization:
Pehla qadam: H₂SO₄(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ H₃O⁺(aq) + HSO₄⁻(aq), pKa1 = −2 (taqatwar acid).
Doosra qadam: HSO₄⁻(aq) + H₂O(l) ⇌ H₃O⁺(aq) + SO₄²⁻(aq), pKa2 = 1.92; musbat qeemat batati hai HSO₄⁻ bohat kamzor acid hai.

Sodium chloride ke saath: NaCl(s) + H₂SO₄(l) → NaHSO₄(s) + HCl(g).

Metals ke saath: hydrogen se ooper wali metals (Fe, Al, Zn, Mn, Ni, Mg) halke acid se hydrogen aur sulfates deti hain: Zn + H₂SO₄ → H₂ + Zn²⁺ + SO₄²⁻. Concentrated acid se SO₂ nikalti hai: Zn + 2H₂SO₄ → SO₂ + Zn²⁺ + SO₄²⁻ + 2H₂O.

book_ref.quote: The equilibrium constant value is greater than that of water

blocks.prompt:
21 6.355 g of copper reacts completely with hot concentrated sulphuric acid. Calculate the mass of H₂SO₄ used and the volume of SO₂ produced. (Cu = 63.55, H₂SO₄ = 98.08 g mol⁻¹; take 1 mol of gas = 22.4 dm³) (4 marks)
(6.355 g copper garam concentrated sulphuric acid se poora react karta hai. Istemal hone wale H₂SO₄ ka mass aur banne wali SO₂ ka hajm nikalein. (Cu = 63.55, H₂SO₄ = 98.08 g mol⁻¹; 1 mol gas = 22.4 dm³ lein))
blocks.explanation: Cu + 2H₂SO₄ → SO₂ + 2H₂O + SO₄²⁻ + Cu²⁺: 1 mol Cu 2 mol H₂SO₄ leta aur 1 mol SO₂ deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Hot concentrated sulphuric acid oxidises Cu, as given below

blocks.prompt:
22 Explain why sulphuric acid is not a typical oxidising agent but hot concentrated acid oxidises copper, and describe its dehydrating action on sugar and ethyl alcohol, with equations. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke sulphuric acid aam oxidising agent kyun nahi magar garam concentrated acid copper ko oxidise karta hai, aur cheeni aur ethyl alcohol par is ka dehydrating amal equations ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Oxidising amal: SO₄²⁻ anion mustahkam aur kamzor oxidising hai, is liye sulphuric acid aam oxidising agent nahi. Garam concentrated acid zyada temperature, zyada H⁺ aur nascent oxygen ki wajah se darmiyana taqatwar oxidiser hai. Cu, Ag, Hg garam concentrated acid se react karte hain:
Cu(s) + 2H₂SO₄(l) → SO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l) + SO₄²⁻(aq) + Cu²⁺(aq)

Dehydrating amal: concentrated acid cheeni, starch, lakri aur kaghaz se paani nikal kar carbon, bhaap aur garmi deta hai. Cheeni se kaala saurakhdaar carbon snake banta hai:
C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁(s) + H₂SO₄(l) → 12C(s) + 11H₂O(g) + H₂SO₄(aq)
Ethyl alcohol se ethene (ya halaat ke mutabiq ethoxyethane):

blocks.prompt:
23 Why is sulphuric acid called the king of chemicals? Describe its main uses and industrial applications. (4 marks)
(Sulphuric acid ko king of chemicals kyun kehte hain? Is ke aham istemal aur sanati applications bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Sulphuric acid ko king of chemicals kehte hain; is ka istemal mulk ki sanati taraqqi ki nishani hai. Bohat si industries mein lagne ke bawajood aakhri product mein kam hi hota hai.

Istemal:
(i) Fertilizers: bara hissa phosphate rock (calcium phosphate) hal karne mein; fluorapatite se single superphosphate Ca(H₂PO₄)₂ aur phosphoric acid (double, triple superphosphate aur ammonium phosphate ke liye); ammonia se ammonium sulfate.
(ii) Ores se Cu, Ni jaisi metals nikalna.
(iii) Oil aur coal refining, polymers, synthetic rubber aur plastics mein catalyst.
(iv) Kaghaz; pesticides, insecticides, herbicides, varnish, dyes, dawaen, sabun aur detergents.
(v) Explosives ke liye nitration: TNT, nitroglycerine, picric acid, nitrocellulose.
(vi) Khurak: cheeni, starch, corn syrup.
(vii) Paint: TiO₂ pigment.
(viii) Gases sukhana; lead storage batteries; laboratory reagent.
